title: Schizophrenia, schizoaffective and bipolar disorder
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's psychiatric condition.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for mood stability.

HPI
Pt is an 83 y.o. female presenting for scheduled psychiatric f/u. Pt reports stable mood over the last month but notes persistent fatigue and occasional lack of motivation. Psychiatrist notes bipolar disorder in partial remission. Pt describes feeling somewhat depressed at times but denies any acute crisis. She reports adherence to current lithium regimen with no significant side effects noted.

Medication List
Lithium carbonate 300mg BID

Exam
Pt is alert and oriented x3. Appears well-groomed. Speech is normal rate/tone. Mood is stable; affect is somewhat constricted. Thought process is linear and goal-directed. No acute distress noted.

Assessment
1. Bipolar disorder in partial remission. Pt remains depressed but stable on current lithium dose.

Plan
1. Continue lithium carbonate 300mg BID.
2. Continue monitoring mood and side effects.
3. F/u in 4 weeks for next psychiatric evaluation.

Electronically signed,
P. O'Brien, PA-C
May 14, 2026
explanations: Bipolar disorder in partial remission, most recent episode depressed: F31.75 (HCC 154).

distractors.why: Partial remission is documented (it keeps HCC 154).
The provider documents remission, not an active episode.
